simple.summary: פֶּרֶךְ (perek) means fracture , i.e. severity First listed occurrence: Exod 1 13.

definitions.full: H6531. perek מֶּ֫רֶךְ noun [masculine] harshness, severity ; — in phrase ׳בְּפ Lev 25:33 , בְּפָ֑רֶךְ 25:43 ; 25:46 ; (H P), Ezek 34:4 (all with רדה rule harshly ); Exod 1:13 (with וַיַּעֲבִדוּ ), 1:14 (with עֲכֹדָה ; both P). II. פרך (√ of following; compare Assyrian parâku , bar, shut off ; parakku , apartment, shrine ; Syriac shrine (see RS JPhil 13, 283 ); see also Muss-Arn JBL xi (1892), 77 Kö ii. 1, 201 ).
